mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, matched_official_question_id, title, subject, chapter, question_type, stem_text, user_answer, image_object_key, image_original_name, image_content_type, image_size, image_sha256, status, analysis_status, mastered, analysis_summary, analysis_knowledge, analysis_steps, analysis_suggestion, analysis_answer, analysis_confidence, failure_message, version, created_at, updated_at FROM personal_questions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, user_id, matched_official_question_id, title, subject, chapter, question_type, stem_text, user_answer, image_object_key, image_original_name, image_content_type, image_size, image_sha256, status, analysis_status, mastered, analysis_summary, analysis_knowledge, analysis_steps, analysis_suggestion, analysis_answer, analysis_confidence, failure_message, version, created_at, updated_at FROM personal_questions WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_questions ( id, user_id, title, subject, chapter, question_type, stem_text, user_answer, image_object_key, image_original_name, image_content_type, image_size, image_sha256, status, analysis_status, mastered, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{subject}, #{chapter}, #{questionType}, #{stemText}, #{userAnswer}, #{imageObjectKey}, #{imageOriginalName}, #{imageContentType}, #{imageSize}, #{imageSha256}, #{status}, #{analysisStatus}, #{mastered}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT credits FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET credits = credits - 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND credits > 0
UPDATE personal_questions SET mastered = #{mastered}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND analysis_status = 'COMPLETED'

UPDATE personal_questions SET analysis_status = 'ANALYZING', failure_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND analysis_status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE personal_questions SET analysis_status = 'COMPLETED', analysis_summary = #{analysis.summary}, analysis_knowledge = #{analysis.knowledge, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.learn.mistakeservice.mybatis.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, analysis_steps = #{analysis.steps, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.learn.mistakeservice.mybatis.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, analysis_suggestion = #{analysis.suggestion}, analysis_answer = #{analysis.answer}, analysis_confidence = #{analysis.confidence}, failure_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND analysis_status = 'ANALYZING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE personal_questions SET analysis_status = 'FAILED', analysis_summary = NULL, analysis_knowledge = NULL, analysis_steps = NULL, analysis_suggestion = NULL, analysis_answer = NULL, analysis_confidence = NULL, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND analysis_status = 'ANALYZING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE personal_questions SET analysis_status = 'QUEUED', failure_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND analysis_status = 'ANALYZING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, version FROM personal_questions WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND analysis_status = 'ANALYZING' AND updated_at < #{expiredBefore} ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE personal_questions SET analysis_status = 'QUEUED', failure_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND analysis_status = 'ANALYZING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE personal_questions SET analysis_status = 'FAILED', failure_message = #{failureMessage}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND analysis_status = 'QUEUED'
